claims.statement: The public SAS Property Tax Payment page labels an entry field for a 10-digit application number or PID number.
claims.notes: The field was observed only; no identifier or owner-name fragment was entered.

claims.statement: The service-details page says the online Property Tax Payment Service is for property owners within Bengaluru City Corporation limits.
The service-details page names net banking as an integrated payment-gateway option.
The service-details page states that the portal provides real-time payment confirmation and receipt generation.
The portal lists the assessment-year 2026–27 rebate period as 01-04-2026 to 30-04-2026.
The portal identifies the Joint Commissioner of Revenue as its Head Office.
For failed online transactions and bank-initiated refunds, the portal advises taxpayers to contact their respective banks.
The portal directs taxpayers with a payment-related issue to raise a ticket through its Grievance section.
The portal directs users with receipt discrepancies to find their ARO and links to a complete list.
The public Receipt Print form asks for a 10-digit application number.
claims.notes: No identifier, year, CAPTCHA, or receipt request was submitted.

claims.statement: The service-details page names debit/credit cards as an integrated payment-gateway option.
The service-details page names UPI as an integrated payment-gateway option.
The service-details page says that the integrated payment gateway supports other digital modes.
The portal lists first-half interest from 01-06-2026.
The portal lists second-half interest from 01-12-2026.
The portal lists penalty as starting on 29-11-2026.
The portal lists NR Square as the Head Office location.
The portal displays telephone contact routes for the Head Office.
The portal displays an email contact route for the Head Office.
The public Receipt Print form asks for an assessment year.
claims.notes: No identifier, year, CAPTCHA, or receipt request was submitted.

cost.searchNote: The current pages name property-tax payment, rebates, interest, and penalties but give no tax amount, fee, or actionable fee schedule for this scenario.

documents.searchNote: Neither reviewed current official page states a document to submit, upload, provide, produce, or attach for payment using a known SAS/PID.

eligibility.actionableValue: Property owners within Bengaluru City Corporation limits.

time.actionableValue: For assessment year 2026–27, the portal lists the rebate period from 01-04-2026 through 30-04-2026; it separately lists first-half interest from 01-06-2026, second-half interest from 01-12-2026, and penalty from 29-11-2026.
time.note: This is a payment-calendar rule, not a processing-time commitment.

owner.actionableValue: Joint Commissioner of Revenue, head office at NR Square, GBA, Bengaluru, with portal-listed telephone and email contacts.

after-submission.actionableValue: The service page states that a user receives real-time payment confirmation and receipt generation.
